message:
We’ve all had those moments in the family group chat where someone asks, "Do we have enough supplies for an emergency?" It’s a great reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to be overwhelming. 

The Red Cross offers some solid guidance on what to include in our survival kits, from food to first-aid essentials. It’s helpful to have a checklist handy so we can gather items together and check them off as a team. 

Let’s embrace this opportunity to bond and ensure we’re all set for whatever may come our way. What’s one item you think is essential for our kit? 😊
